ideas.pitch: A human-in-the-loop invoice generator that runs structured entity extraction via an LLM and cross-references a secure price catalog using strict lookup constraints to prevent hallucination.
ideas.title: AegisInvoice Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly nails the core challenge workflow and explicitly prevents AI price fabrication, which aligns with judges looking for robust enterprise guardrails similar to audited agent workflows.

ideas.pitch: An intent-based natural language invoice parser that uses a semantic router to route customer messaging to correct pricing tables and service SKU lookups without hardcoded templates.
ideas.title: ChatToBill Semantic Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced routing patterns to ensure high-accuracy entity extraction from messy, colloquial customer strings in under 180 minutes.

ideas.pitch: A rapid Streamlit application that ingests unstructured customer chat logs, extracts line items via structured JSON outputs, queries an active Excel/Google Sheet database, and outputs a downloadable PDF review-ready invoice.
ideas.title: SheetSync Invoice Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on smooth UI/UX and zero-latency database fetching, satisfying the exact evaluation criteria for review-ready output generation.

ideas.pitch: An invoice automation tool featuring a multi-step validation check that rejects unrecognized items, throwing a manual review flag whenever a customer requests a service not present in the connected database.
ideas.title: GuardInvoice Zero-Fabrication Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit requirement that the AI must not fabricate prices by implementing a deterministic fallback check.

ideas.pitch: A multi-format ingestion tool that parses customer messages from email text, WhatsApp screenshots, or raw chat logs, extracts invoice parameters, and queries Airtable for matching SKUs.
ideas.title: OmniParse Billing Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Handles chaotic real-world inputs while keeping the backend pricing strictly constrained to an external database source.
